text: Every call Quo transcribes has to be filed or waved off, so the record shows what we told the family. If a call is still unfiled at six p.m., whoever made it gets a task.
Casey called Maria Rivera yesterday and never filed it.
The one thing to remember: file the call, or click Don't file. Either one closes the task straight away.
Your unfiled calls also wait in this dock, wherever you are in Scout. Filing there closes the task too.
Open the task. The call is right here.
Nothing worth keeping? Don't file closes the task too.
This one matters, so click File to chart.
Make sure Maple is ticked, the pet the call was about. It goes on her chart as a communication note.
The call is on Maple's chart, it's gone from your dock, and the task is closed.

The most common mistakes: letting calls pile up in the dock, and calling the family again because the task looked like a new callback. Remember: file the call, or click Don't file. Either one closes the task straight away.
